steps.title: Configure project metadata
steps.description: Define the unique app name 'Donkey World' and package name 'com.donkeyworld.app' to initialize custom builds.

steps.title: Establish strict build environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle to use JDK 17, target Android SDK 34, compile SDK 34, and use standard non-AndroidX native components.

steps.title: Set up standard manifest structure
steps.description: Declare package name, launcher activity, single screen orientation, and link app icons to standard drawables.

steps.title: Design user interface layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml containing a responsive header, frame layout for dynamic screen switching, and styled tab navigation buttons.

steps.title: Create facts screen engine
steps.description: Implement fact carousel logic inside MainActivity, presenting precompiled engaging facts about donkeys.

steps.title: Develop Donkey bray synthesizer
steps.description: Use AudioTrack API to synthetically generate distinct 'Hee' and 'Haw' audio frequencies programmatically.

steps.title: Implement Donkey clicker game
steps.description: Program click handlers, dynamic ascii animation, carrot point counter, and levelling system for interactive donkey care.

steps.title: Incorporate persistent game storage
steps.description: Implement SharedPreferences storage to persist carrot progress, levels, and unlocked facts across app relaunches.

steps.title: Validate layout styling and resources
steps.description: Verify system Material theme compatibility, safe color variables, and pure Java-8 backward compatibility features.

steps.title: Building Donkey World
steps.description: Assemble debug APK with optimal configurations for target mobile devices.
